title: Smart runbook stub generator and queryable incident snapshots
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Add ability to capture compact, queryable incident snapshots and generate initial runbook stubs from alerts; new CLI helpers for retrieving/redacting snapshots; feature flag rollout behind rb-snapshot-index; backward-compatible with existing runbook templates.
files_changed: src/snapshots/indexer.go; src/snapshots/store.go; src/runbook/stub_generator.go; cli/snapshot_cmd.go; tests/snapshots_test.go; e2e/fixture_runbook_flow.yaml; docs/runbook-snapshots.md; pkg/redaction/sanitizer.go; ci/workflows/runbook-snapshots.yml; telemetry/metrics_registry.go; scripts/migrate_snapshots_v1_to_v2.sh; examples/oncall_quick_query.md
commits: 3 commits: (1) initial snapshot indexer and store API; (2) runbook stub generator + CLI to fetch snapshots; (3) redaction sanitizers, tests, and docs; commit messages: 'snapshots: compact index and store', 'runbook: generate stubs from snapshot fingerprints', 'safety: scrub secrets from snapshots, add tests and docs'
description:
Motivation: On-call responders frequently need a compact contextual snapshot of recent telemetry and a starting runbook draft tied to an alert fingerprint. Today responders copy links and manually assemble runbook skeletons; this PR introduces a compact, queryable incident snapshot format and a runbook-stub generator that pre-fills playbook sections based on the snapshot and alert metadata. The feature is behind the feature flag 'rb-snapshot-index' and is fully backward compatible with existing runbook templates.

What this PR does (single-line summary): Adds a snapshot indexer/store, a CLI endpoint to retrieve/redact snapshots, the runbook-stub generator, safety redaction, tests, docs, and a small migration helper for previous snapshot exports.

Checklist:
- [x] Snapshot index schema and store (compact gzipped JSON + minimal index).
- [x] CLI command: `incident-bot snapshot get <fingerprint>` with `--redact` option.
- [x] Runbook stub generator that emits sections: overview, impact assessment, immediate mitigations, triage steps, rollback hints.
- [x] Redaction sanitizer (KMS-backed PII/secret redaction interface).
- [x] Unit tests for indexer, store, and stub generator.
- [x] E2E fixture validating the quick-query => stub flow.
- [x] Docs and example usage in docs/runbook-snapshots.md and examples.
- [x] Feature flag gating and migration script for v1 exports.

Design notes: Snapshots are stored as compressed payloads keyed by an alert fingerprint (sha1 of normalized alert + timeframe). The index stores metadata (timestamp, alert id, top-5 hosts, metric fingerprints, traces sampled) to enable fast listing and recall without full payload expansion. The runbook-stub generator uses a ruleset mapping (rules derived from SRE-332) to pre-populate headings. Redaction runs as a last step and supports pluggable scrubbers; we provide a simple KMS token check and pattern-based scrubber in pkg/redaction/sanitizer.go.

CI / checks:
- Unit: pass (snapshots_test.go covers indexer edge cases).
- Integration: initially failed on flaky e2e that relied on external telemetry emulator; fixed by adding a deterministic fixture and retry in e2e workflow.
- Lint: pass.
- Security scan: pass after adding kube secret avoidance in store logic.

Review conversation (high-level):
- Diego Ramos: Requested stronger guarantees that snapshots never contain plaintext secrets and suggested KMS-backed envelope encryption for the store.
  - Author: Added redaction sanitizers and a KMS-token check before storing; also documented encryption recommendations.
- Lena Park: Asked for test coverage around large snapshot sizes and index read path under high cardinality.
  - Author: Added tests that simulate 20k host fingerprints and validated index compaction heuristics; added a guard to fall back to sampling when payloads exceed threshold.
- Ethan Blake: Suggested UX tweaks for the CLI and default redact-on-fetch behavior.
  - Author: CLI now defaults to `--redact=true` and added `--raw` for internal use.
- Final: Diego approved after confirming redaction and encryption notes; Lena approved after tests added.

Files changed (high level):
- src/snapshots/indexer.go: adds compact index format, background compaction scheduler.
- src/snapshots/store.go: store API (Put/Get/Delete), gzipped payloads, optional KMS envelope encryption hook.
- src/runbook/stub_generator.go: generation rules and templating for runbook stubs.
- cli/snapshot_cmd.go: new CLI surface for ops and oncall.
- pkg/redaction/sanitizer.go: simple scrubber and integration point for customer KMS/HSM.
- tests/snapshots_test.go: unit+integration tests.
- e2e/fixture_runbook_flow.yaml: deterministic fixture used in CI.
- docs/runbook-snapshots.md: usage, migration, security notes.

Migration notes: A migration helper script scripts/migrate_snapshots_v1_to_v2.sh is included to convert older JSON export blobs into the compact, indexed format. The migration is optional; feature flag controls new index registration.

Rollout: The change is behind the feature flag 'rb-snapshot-index' and rolled out in two phases: (1) indexer + store in read-only mode (no indexes registered), (2) enable index registration for projects opted into the feature. The CLI and runbook generator are available but will return lightweight fallbacks when the index is disabled.

Follow-ups:
- Add KV-cache to snapshot store for very hot fingerprints (ENG-1379).
- Wire snapshot recall into alert-enrichment pipeline to prefetch snapshots on firing alerts (SRE-400).
- Add RBAC for snapshot access and audit entries for fetches (security follow-up).

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals and CI green. The e2e was re-run twice to mitigate emulator flakiness; CI now shows green.
review_comments: Diego: 'We need a strong guarantee snapshots never leak credentials; add redaction and note KMS integration.' / Aisha: 'Added sanitizer + KMS token gating, documented tradeoffs.'; Lena: 'Add load tests for index path.' / Aisha: 'Added a synthetic host-cardinality test and compaction guard.'; Ethan: 'CLI UX: default to redact.' / Aisha: 'Changed CLI to default redact, added --raw for internal ops.'
notes_for_release: Ops teams: enable 'rb-snapshot-index' per-project to opt-in; snapshot storage size is capped by default (config: snapshots.max_payload_bytes). See docs/runbook-snapshots.md for migration steps and security considerations.
security_considerations: Snapshots are redacted by default on fetch; storage supports envelope encryption; administrators should rotate KMS keys per best practices. Avoid enabling index registration for untrusted projects until RBAC is in place.
e2e_status: deterministic fixture added; e2e initially flaked once due to external telemetry emulator; fixed by using fixture_runbook_flow.yaml and retry logic; final run passed.
testing_summary: Unit tests: indexer edge cases, store put/get/delete, redaction sanitizer; Integration: CLI fetch + redact flow; E2E: fixture validates quick-query->stub flow; coverage increased by ~7% for incident-bot package.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the snapshot payload format compact and versioned to allow future schema evolution; when rolling back, we ensure the CLI falls back to raw export retrieval.
